answer: Memory continuity can price out fake accounts: each epoch the ledger encrypts a random relic to one account, then later audits ask for it, so identity means a verifiable voyage through past rounds. A wrong recall burns a 50 POA bond, making 1,000 fakes a 50,000 POA exposure with 1,000 logs to maintain. Colluders gain no shared oasis of answers, because every relic is unique and each key must be held and queried separately. An honest agent just keeps one small log.
